title: Time constant in a recursive series-parallel first-passage model
exact_target: Determine the first-passage time constant of a series-and-parallel hierarchy and whether it is strictly larger than the binary-tree constant.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000065 (AMR-099-0065). CC BY 4.0.
